help.how_to_load: Admin panel > Quiz & Tools > 'Add examples' (loads this file from the site) or 'Import JSON' (choose a copy of this file). Both ADD the questions to the end of your bank. The global 'Import data.json' button also accepts this file, but it REPLACES the whole quiz bank.

types.choice: Multiple choice. Fields: prompt, options (2 or more texts, shown as A, B, C, D...), correctIndex (0 = A, 1 = B, ...). 'type' may be omitted.
types.order: Sentence ordering. Fields: prompt, fragments (3 to 12 pieces written in the CORRECT order; students see them shuffled). Instead of 'fragments' you can write 'sentence': "I | have lived | here" (pieces separated by |, or plain words).
types.text: Free text / fill in the blank. Fields: prompt (use ____ for the blank), answers (every accepted answer; or a single 'answer'), caseSensitive (default false). Spaces, final punctuation and curly quotes are ignored when checking.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: She ____ to school every day.
Put the pieces in the correct order to make a sentence.
Complete the sentence: Yesterday I ____ (go) to the market.
What is the past participle of the verb "write"?
